source: mock fixtures for stage 0 (task brief): TEST10 = -10 %, PIC100 = 100 % promo with an immediately paid order
notes: Promo codes are demo fixtures, not live marketing data.
Percent promos discount the merchandise subtotal only; the 100 % promo discounts the whole order (including delivery) so the total is exactly 0.
Discount is computed server-side with integer floor: discountMinor = subtotalMinor * percent / 100.
